question: Inside the red box two marks sit on the stem below the high note: A just above the top staff line, B lower on the staff. What is A -- a second notehead (a half note) or a tremolo slash? Is B a tremolo slash?
sean_words: A is a half note sitting right above the staff, and B is a tremolo slash.

marks.A: half note (notehead), just above the top staff line
